title: Butchery and Intra-Site Analysis of Animal Bone: A Case Study from Danebury Hillfort, Hampshire, England: PhD Thesis, University of Leicester (2002).
description: This Phd thesis explores the questions of status divisions, specialised activity and task areas, meat consumption, ritual and structured deposition, and addresses a main theme: what was the status of hillforts in the Iron Age?
